nodes.label: Blade-Element Aerodynamics
nodes.rationale: Airflow at each segment includes body motion and joint motion so a downstroke pushes air.

nodes.label: Coupled Wing and Body Dynamics
nodes.rationale: A 12-degree-of-freedom solution includes recoil, changing inertia, and the body's response to joint stops.

nodes.label: Energy Budget
nodes.rationale: Muscle work and resting metabolism drain reserves. Rings restore energy and depleted birds have to glide.

nodes.label: Flight Reward
nodes.rationale: Progress and successful ring passes are rewarded. Crashes and control effort are penalized.

nodes.label: Wing and Tail Joint Actuation
nodes.rationale: Per-surface control and momentum-based flight let the policy discover flapping without scripted thrust.

nodes.label: Ring Radius Curriculum
nodes.rationale: Ring radius shrinks as the birds improve.

nodes.label: Soaring and Thermals
nodes.rationale: The combination of soaring and an energy budget rewards gaining height in thermals.

nodes.label: Bird Species Scaling
nodes.rationale: Physical and course parameters scale from species measurements, and each policy trains with its own species.

nodes.label: Wing Physics Modes
nodes.rationale: Checkpoints carry the selected physics so earlier massless and wing-momentum policies remain usable.

nodes.label: Windows CUDA Setup
nodes.rationale: The Windows launcher checks that PyTorch actually uses the GPU and selects a compatible build if needed.
